infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 110 in the two story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 110 key (Dorm 110) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the two-story dormitory with a tag reading "110" on it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter Accidental Witness

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- In warehouse #17 in a locker located in the changing room on the first floor next to the staircase behind the wall paintings. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

- In warehouse #6 in a locker

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first floor of the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Safe
- Possible Fuel conditioner, Metal fuel tank, Secure Flash drive and Diary spawn (on the bed).
- Possible Car battery on the bedside table.
- Possible Intelligence folder spawn inside the bedside cabinet.
- Possible loose Valuable at the bottom of the closet
